title: text paragraphs 33
content:
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in fiscal Q4 was $33.42, up 33% sequentially.

Cash flow and capital expenditures

Turning to cash flow and capital expenditures, in fiscal Q4, operating cash flows were $44.0 billion. Capital

expenditures were $10.8 billion, resulting in free cash flow of $33.2 billion. As noted in previous

disclosures, customer cash deposits associated with SCAs are reported within financing activities and

therefore do not affect our free cash flow. Customer cash deposits received during fiscal Q4 were $12.3

billion.
